H01-pos1.label: violation
H01-pos1.note: Domain pricing policy imports the SubscribeCommand type from the application layer.

H01-pos2.label: violation
H01-pos2.note: Domain invoice imports the typeorm framework package to generate ids.

H01-twin1.label: clean
H01-twin1.note: Same VIP pricing feature, with the request type defined inside the domain.

H01-twin2.label: clean
H01-twin2.note: Same factory, with the id and time supplied by the caller instead of a framework package.

H01-legit.label: clean
H01-legit.note: Domain policy imports another domain module (ProrationService), which is allowed.

H02-pos1.label: violation
H02-pos1.note: Subscribe use case imports and depends on the InMemoryPlanRepository adapter instead of the port.

H02-pos2.label: violation
H02-pos2.note: Generate-invoice use case imports the ProviderPaymentGateway adapter directly.

H02-twin1.label: clean
H02-twin1.note: Subscribe use case adds a blank-customer guard and still depends only on ports.

H02-twin2.label: clean
H02-twin2.note: Generate-invoice use case numbers invoices through the InvoiceRepository port.

H02-legit.label: clean
H02-legit.note: Use case imports the port interface (type-only) and retries the charge through it.

H03-pos1.label: violation
H03-pos1.note: The inbound HTTP controller imports the outbound persistence adapter and queries it directly.

H03-pos2.label: violation
H03-pos2.note: The payment gateway adapter imports and constructs the email sender adapter.

H03-twin1.label: clean
H03-twin1.note: Subscription lookup endpoint reaches persistence through a new in-port and use case, wired in main.

H03-twin2.label: clean
H03-twin2.note: Gateway reports charges through an injected callback; main connects it to the email sender.

H03-legit.label: clean
H03-legit.note: Both adapters are built in main.ts; the gateway only sees the NotificationSender port.

H04-pos1.label: violation
H04-pos1.note: Out-port refund signature takes the vendor SDK Charge type from stripe.

H04-pos2.label: violation
H04-pos2.note: Out-port method exposes a SQL transaction handle in its signature.

H04-twin1.label: clean
H04-twin1.note: Refund added to the port using only a primitive id and the domain Money type.

H04-twin2.label: clean
H04-twin2.note: Batch save added to the port with domain types only; transaction handling stays in the adapter.

H04-legit.label: clean
H04-legit.note: Port declares its own plain receipt shape with primitives, resembling provider data but importing no vendor type.

H05-pos1.label: violation
H05-pos1.note: Subscribe use case constructs SmtpEmailSender itself as a fallback.

H05-pos2.label: violation
H05-pos2.note: Cancel use case defaults its repository to a new InMemorySubscriptionRepository.

H05-twin1.label: clean
H05-twin1.note: Use case uses new only for domain objects (Invoice, ProrationService), never for an adapter.

H05-twin2.label: clean
H05-twin2.note: Cancel use case only constructs a Date; the repository is injected.

H05-legit.label: clean
H05-legit.note: main.ts, the composition root, constructs the adapters with configuration and injects them.

H06-pos1.label: violation
H06-pos1.note: Controller computes proration, loyalty discount and eligibility itself.

H06-pos2.label: violation
H06-pos2.note: Invoice repository adapter applies late-fee and tax rules before persisting.

H06-twin1.label: clean
H06-twin1.note: Controller validates the quote request and delegates the proration math to the domain service.

H06-twin2.label: clean
H06-twin2.note: Invoice repository only maps the invoice to a stored row; amounts are untouched.

H06-legit.label: clean
H06-legit.note: Controller only checks request format (types, id pattern); no pricing or eligibility logic.

H07-pos1.label: violation
H07-pos1.note: Subscribe use case throws errors carrying HTTP status codes 404 and 409.

H07-pos2.label: violation
H07-pos2.note: Domain subscription throws an HttpStatusError(409) instead of a domain error.

H07-twin1.label: clean
H07-twin1.note: Cancel use case signals the conflict with a domain error; no transport concept.

H07-twin2.label: clean
H07-twin2.note: Domain error gains a business reason code instead of a status code.

H07-legit.label: clean
H07-legit.note: Domain errors are mapped to HTTP statuses (402, 403, 422) in the inbound adapter only.
